acquisition_method.evidence: We performed library-based DIA proteomic analysis of post-exercise skeletal muscle biopsies collected from individuals which spanned a range of glucose metabolism disorders: normal, prediabetes, and T2D.
Data-dependent (DDA) and independent analyses (DIA) were conducted.
